validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from native 200-dpi crops of each spread plus zooms on dense tables; tesseract used only as a cross-check. Each section was diffed against 8-3170 and 8-3160 (same ref and part number). Numerical index (printed pp46-49) OCR'd per column and per row, compared with an expected index rendered from the transcription in both directions, mismatches checked by eye.
validation.refContinuity: Continuous except printed gaps: chassis_hood refs 58-63, motion_drive refs 47-59, transaxle refs 16, 19, 24, 63 and 72-74. Repeated refs kept as printed: flywheel_crankshaft 12 and 13, engine_block 22 and 26. Ref 0 (unnumbered) on carburetor (3 rows) and starter (1 row). Electrical 37A/37B.
validation.quantities: Every row carries a qty except mower_suspension 34, steering 39 and motion_drive 91. UAR on engine_block 6 and 7, blower_housing 9 and 10, gasket_sets 7 and 8. Inch quantities kept as printed (chassis trim strip 77.5", engine control 10"). Chassis ref 33 qty is an illegible dot, stored 1 and flagged.
validation.numericalIndex: All 794 part-number entries expected from the transcription were located in the printed index (12 columns, pp46-49). OCR noise accounted for every other difference. One genuine conflict: the index prints C39947 at 31/23 where the table prints C34497 (transaxle ref 23); table kept and flagged. Ref-0 parts are listed in the index with no ref. NSS rows have no part number and are not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs 'BR' numbers stored bare, Case letter prefixes closed up (C35064), hardware codes as NNN-NN. '*' and '**' part-number cells stored as NSS with the footnote; footnote marks on part numbers removed from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted.
